sections.name: LifeScoreGauge
sections.title: Life score ring and number
sections.what: Shows a card titled Life Balance Score with a ring filled to the score and the number in the centre. The score is worked out from habits, tasks, goals and focus sessions, and a short note explains what it measures.
sections.why: Likely reason: gives one at-a-glance measure of overall balance on the dashboard.
sections.watch_out: The ring length assumes the score stays between 0 and 100, so a value outside that range draws the ring incorrectly.

summary: A card showing a Life Balance Score as a circular ring filled to the score, with the number in the centre.
purpose: Gives the user a single number that sums up how balanced their habits, tasks, goals and focus are.
why: Likely reason: one glance at overall balance on the dashboard.
how: The component reads habits, tasks, goals and focus sessions from the shared store. It passes them to calculateLifeScore to get a number. It then draws a grey background ring and an orange ring whose visible length matches that number, with the number in the middle.
inputs: The four lists from the shared store: habits, tasks, goals and focus sessions. No props.
outputs: A styled card with the score number and the ring. Nothing is saved.
risks: The ring length assumes the score is between 0 and 100. calculateLifeScore was not in the packet, so its rules and any error handling are not known here.
debug: If the number looks wrong, check calculateLifeScore and the data it receives. If the ring looks wrong while the number is right, check that the score stays within 0 to 100. If the card is empty, check that the store returns lists rather than nothing.
